title: rbGyanX shipped NTCP model parameters
description: The LKB / relative-seriality parameter values rbGyanX itself uses, exposed so a comparison against them is arithmetic rather than a model's recollection. Since v1.5.0 each entry carries the source, table and page the value was transcribed from, or states that it has none.
applicability: These are the tool's own defaults, not a clinical standard. A site that overrides them in site_params_ntcp_user.yaml should regenerate this pack. An entry whose citation says 'no published source' is illustrative: BASIC mode refuses it and ADVANCED mode labels it.
